consent_modal.title: We value your privacy
consent_modal.description: We use essential cookies to keep this website working. With your permission, we also use analytics to improve the experience and marketing cookies to measure campaigns. You can accept all, reject optional cookies, or choose by category and vendor.

preferences_modal.title: Cookie Settings
preferences_modal.description: You are in control of your data. Essential cookies are always active because the website needs them to work. Choose which optional categories and vendors you allow, and expand each item to see its purpose, provider and cookies. Your choices take effect when you save them.
preferences_modal.more_info: This is an illustrative website configuration with real vendor names and example cookie settings. No analytics or advertising tags are loaded in this demo. Cookie durations can vary by site configuration and browser. You can return to these settings at any time using the cookie icon.
